svg.aria-label: A visitor reaches one App Runner instance in ap-southeast-1 serving the FastAPI and React viewer from an image that has the runs, the ledger and the agent versions baked in; GitHub Actions deploys by OIDC to ECR after CI is green; a CloudWatch alarm watches 5xx responses; there is no database and no model call.

g.title: visitor — no login; the viewer is public and read-only
GitHub Actions — deploy-aws.yml runs only after ci.yml succeeds on main, assumes an OIDC role with no stored keys, builds the image and applies Terraform
App Runner — service dabstep-demo, one instance at 0.5 vCPU and 1 GB, port 8080, health check on /healthz, one uvicorn worker; auto-deploys when ECR :latest changes

the evidence, inside the image — agents/, runs/, loop/, data/tasks/ and the data sample copied in at build; DEMO_MODE=1 and BILLING=none set in the Dockerfile so the container cannot make a model call
ECR — repository dabstep-demo, scan on push, lifecycle keeps the five most recent images; rollback is retagging a previous :sha as :latest
CloudWatch — alarm dabstep-demo-5xx: ten 5xx responses across two five-minute periods
